Australia will play Egypt as the two countries look to secure a spot in the final 16 of the 2026 World Cup. (Getty Images: Matt McNulty)

The Socceroos continue their World Cup campaign on Saturday as they look to make it through to the Round of 16.

After drawing with Paraguay to secure second spot in their group the Socceroos now take on Egypt.

Here is everything you need to know ahead of kick-off.

The Socceroos will be playing Egypt.

In their first match of the World Cup, the Socceroos had a 2-0 win over Türkiye, before losing to the United States in their second match, 0-2. They then drew 0-0 with Paraguay to secure second spot in their group.

The Socceroos posing for photos with fans after their win over Türkiye. (Reuters: Agustin Marcarian)

Egypt made it through as the second-placed team in Group G.

In a chaotic conclusion to that group the Egyptians moved in and out of second place as they eventually drew with Iran 1-1, having already drawn with Belgium 1-1, and beaten New Zealand 3-1.

Egypt is currently ranked 26th in the world. Australia is ranked 28th.

The game is on Saturday, July 4, at 4am (AEST).

Here's the start time for your time zone:

The Socceroos will be playing at Dallas Stadium, famously the home of the NFL's Dallas Cowboys.

If you want to make a day of it, you can watch the game from live sites. These are the confirmed official live sites via Football Australia as of Thursday, July 2.

Should Australia make it through against Egypt, they would next play on Wednesday, July 8 at 2am (AEST) in Atlanta. That would be 1:30am ACST and midnight AWST.

Australia would play the winner of the match between reigning champions Argentina and fairytale story Cabo Verde, which is played at 8am on Saturday (AEST) and will be live-blogged by ABC Sport after the Australia vs Egypt clash.

ABC Sport is live-blogging every World Cup game, and we have extensive coverage of all the tournament's biggest storylines here.

You can watch all Socceroos matches live on SBS and SBS On Demand.
